en.headline: Law firm reportedly to move from Central to Hysan Lee Garden Eight
en.dek: Market sources say Woo Kwan Lee & Lo has reserved about 39,000 square feet in the Causeway Bay development after more than 50 years in Jardine House.
body: Hong Kong law firm Woo Kwan Lee & Lo is reported to be relocating from Central to Hysan Development’s Lee Garden Eight in Causeway Bay, according to market sources and local media.

The firm, founded in 1973 and with about 250 partners and staff, has occupied space in Jardine House for more than five decades. Sources said it has reserved roughly 39,000 square feet, taking an entire low-to-middle floor in the mixed-use complex, which is due for completion this quarter.
Lee Garden Eight is a joint project of Hysan and Chinachem Group on Caroline Hill. The firm declined to comment when approached. No official confirmation of the lease has been issued.
The reported move comes as Causeway Bay continues to attract office tenants seeking space outside traditional Central locations.

zh.headline: 有消息指律師行將由中環遷往希慎利園八期
zh.dek: 市場消息稱胡關李羅律師行預留約3.9萬平方呱，結束在怡和大廈超過50年的租用。
body: 據市場消息及本地傳媒報道，香港律師行胡關李羅律師行計劃由中環遷往銅鑼灣希慎興業的利園八期。
該行於1973年成立，約有250名合夥人及員工，在怡和大廈已租用超過50年。消息指其已預留約39,000平方呱，佔用一層低至中層樓面。利園八期預計本季落成。
利園八期由希慎與華懋集團合作發展，位於加路連山。律師行拒絕置評，租約亦未有官方確認。
有關搬遷反映銅鑼灣繼續吸引希望離開傳統中環辦公室的租戶。
更正：先前版本中文部分有字符錯誤，已修正。
